rules.statement: A person can claim a way of necessity for the purpose of going from one land owned by him to another, but the right of way will not be granted if there is an alternative route to the one claimed, although such route may be less convenient and involve a longer and more arduous journey.
rules.supporting_quote: A person can claim a way of necessity for the purpose of going from one land owned by him to another. The right of way will not be granted, if there is an alternative route to the one claimed although such route may be less convenient and involve a longer and more arduous journey.
